description:
Maker 3D CAD - the middle ground between Tinkercad and FreeCAD.

Materializr is open-source 3D CAD for makers - the middle ground between
dead-simple tools like Tinkercad and full professional suites like FreeCAD.
Sketch on a plane, pull it into a solid (extrude, revolve, loft, sweep),
fillet and chamfer, run booleans, cut threads, and edit any step of the
history later. Sketches export to SVG and DXF at 1:1 mm for laser cutters and
2.5D CNC; it imports STEP, IGES, BREP, STL, SVG and DXF, and exports STEP,
STL, IGES, BREP, glTF, OBJ, 3MF, SVG and DXF. Real B-rep solids on the
OpenCASCADE kernel.
Materializr 1.7.2
Added
- Move type-in panel: type an exact X / Y / Z offset for the Translate gizmo in your display unit
- The Rotate type-in panel now appears for any body, sketch or sketch plus body, with persistent fields and an Undo for the last Apply
- Optional measurements on selection in sketches (Settings > Sketch): lengths, diameters, radii, arc sweep and a running total
Changed
- History and Lay Flat report axes Z-up, matching the ViewCube
- Interface translations grew from 1192 to 1436 strings in all five languages
Fixed
- Long traced outlines (a single spline with hundreds of control points) no longer freeze Extrude, orbit clicks or project load
- A committed sketch is recovered after a crash
- Much faster meshing of extruded and boolean-trimmed walls: STL export of a lettering-heavy part went from 82 s to 0.1 s
- A valid union is no longer refused with "an operand was lost" on bodies with large B-spline faces
- Error toasts raised after a long operation stay on screen
- Sketch inference follows edges past the first point of a chain, and snap ranges follow the visible grid
- ViewCube phantom click, a duplicate Lathe button, and swapped Y/Z panel colours
Also rolls up 1.7.0 (Assembly Mates, AI Assistant, display units) and 1.7.1 (Items panel drag-and-drop), which were not submitted to winget.
